environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING limiting query string to 2048 bytes; (2) Priority 200 - A custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that rewrites any request URI containing encoded characters beyond %20-%7E (printable ASCII range) to a fixed 400 response. The ECS task role has no network egress beyond the ALB and ECR pull. CloudWatch Logs Insights query runs every 60s looking for 'UNION' or 'SELECT' in access logs and triggers SNS notification.

rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
rules.note: Includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING (blocks query strings > 2048 bytes) and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING and GenericRFI_QUERYSTRING among others

rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
rules.note: All rules in default BLOCK action including SQLi_QUERYSTRING, SQLi_BODY, SQLi_COOKIE which use transformation functions toLower, urlDecode, htmlEntityDecode before pattern matching

config.alb_listener_rules: default forward, no URI rewrite (standard config)
config.ecs_task_networking: awsvpc mode, security group allows inbound from ALB SG only on port 8080
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights scheduled query every 60s
